title: Ad XII/Meduacus Maior
description: BAtlDir, following Bosio 1991, offers two possible modern associations for this attested Roman road station at or near the Meduacus Maior estuary north of the Po delta: Dolo or Sambruson.

properties.description: 1:500,000 scale representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
